meta.title: Editing Rates & Services | Double Dag Productions
meta.description: Transparent video editing rates for documentary, series, branded, and digital content. Day rates, project packages, retainers, and add-ons from Emmy-recognized editor Ben Bacharach-White.

hero.heading: Expert Video Editing — Built for Story, Not Just Assembly
hero.intro: I'm a senior editor with over two decades of experience shaping documentaries, series, and high-end digital content. This isn't just cutting footage — it's editorial judgment, pacing, structure, and polish that elevates the final piece.
hero.note: Clear pricing helps you plan, but don't let the numbers scare you. Final quotes are always tailored to your project, and I'm absolutely open to working with Non-Profits, students, small productions, and people with limited budgets when I can.

tiers.name: Day Rate
tiers.description: Best for ongoing projects, collaborative edits, or agency work.

tiers.name: Hourly
tiers.description: Used for smaller updates, fixes, or overflow work.

tiers.name: Project Minimum
tiers.description: Ensures proper time for quality editorial work.

packages.heading: Structured options for common needs
packages.intro: Packages are starting points — scope, complexity, and timeline shape the final estimate.

bullets.text: Advanced pacing, tone, and narrative flow

howPricingWorks.heading: Every project is different. Pricing is based on:

items.question: How many revisions are included?
items.answer: Most projects include 1–2 rounds. Additional revisions are billed hourly.

items.question: Do you work hourly or per project?
items.answer: Both. Projects are typically fixed-rate; ongoing work is often hourly or retainer-based.

items.question: Can you match a lower budget?
items.answer: If scope can be adjusted, sometimes. The focus is always maintaining quality.

items.question: Do you handle raw footage organization?
items.answer: Yes — but heavily disorganized footage may affect pricing.

cta.heading: Let's talk about your project.
cta.body: Tell me what you're working on, and I'll put together a tailored estimate.
